workflows.name: release-pipeline
workflows.description: Build or fix a CI/CD pipeline that tests, builds, and releases a service through gated environments.
workflows.use_when: The request asks to create, fix, speed up or harden a GitLab CI or GitHub Actions pipeline, or to set up build, release and deploy jobs for a service.
examples: Add a gated production deploy with a migration job and automatic rollback to the payments-api pipeline for v3.8.0.

workflows.name: security-scan
workflows.description: Scan code, dependencies, images, and IaC, triage the findings, and add the scans as pipeline gates.
workflows.use_when: The request asks to run or add SAST, secret, dependency, container image or IaC scans, to triage scanner findings, or to produce an SBOM or signed image.
examples: Add a pre-release security gate for payment-service v2.5.0: semgrep, trivy for the repo and the image, gitleaks, and checkov.

workflows.name: iac-change
workflows.description: Provision, change, fix drift in, or destroy infrastructure through Terraform or Ansible with a reviewed plan.
workflows.use_when: The request asks to provision, change, import, fix drift in, or destroy cloud or server infrastructure defined in Terraform, OpenTofu or Ansible.
examples: Provision a staging environment with Terraform: private network 10.20.0.0/16, three worker VMs, and one load balancer.

workflows.name: debug-workload
workflows.description: Diagnose a failing Kubernetes workload and fix it in the manifests or Helm values.
workflows.use_when: The request reports a pod in CrashLoopBackOff, Pending, ImagePullBackOff, OOMKilled, failing probes, or a Service with no endpoints in Kubernetes.
examples: payment-service is in CrashLoopBackOff every 30 seconds since the v2.3.1 deploy; find the cause and fix it.

workflows.name: incident-response
workflows.description: Investigate an alert or production incident, mitigate it, fix the cause, and write the incident page.
workflows.use_when: The request reports a firing alert, an outage, elevated errors or latency, a database incident, or asks for a postmortem of a production event.
examples: order-service returns 100% 5xx since 15:42 UTC and checkout is down; help me mitigate and find the cause.

workflows.name: add-migration
workflows.description: Add a backward-compatible database schema migration with rollback and tests.
workflows.use_when: The request asks to add, rename, drop or change a table, column, index or constraint in a service database through a migration.
examples: Rename users.full_name to users.display_name without downtime.

workflows.name: code-review-workflow
workflows.description: Review a merge request or diff against its requirements and the review regulation, with evidence per finding.
workflows.use_when: The request asks to review an existing pull request, merge request or diff and give review comments.
examples: Review MR !87 "Add rate limiting to the public API".

workflows.name: debug-issue
workflows.description: Find the root cause of a bug, fix it with a regression test, and record the cause.
workflows.use_when: The request reports wrong behaviour, an error, a crash, a failing test or a regression in application code and asks to find the cause and fix it.
examples: POST /orders returns 500 when the cart holds a discounted item; find the cause and fix it.

workflows.name: develop-feature
workflows.description: Turn a feature request into working code with tests and an up-to-date feature docs page.
workflows.use_when: The request asks to build, add or change behaviour in code: a feature, an endpoint, a small program or script, or any coding task that no narrower workflow fits.
examples: Add subscription cancellation: DELETE /subscriptions/{id} records a reason and keeps access until the period ends.

workflows.name: refactor-module
workflows.description: Restructure a module without changing its observable behaviour, guarded by tests.
workflows.use_when: The request asks to restructure, extract, rename, split or clean up existing code while keeping its behaviour the same.
examples: Move the business logic from OrderController into OrderService.
